Judged with a clean context, read-only, on `d:\work\ai_sandbox\ndim` (branch `main`). Every claim
below was re-executed, not read. Nothing in the tree was modified by this pass.

**Headline:** the update is real and the work is honest. 9 of 11 claims verify outright. Two claims
are **false as stated** — claim 3 (the rehearsal file was *not* consumed and still sits on disk) and
half of claim 7 (`scenario-lint check` exits 0, not 3). Neither is concealment: the agent's own
ticket `bugs/KAIF/05` documents the claim-3 behaviour against itself, with the same evidence I
found independently, and delivered it to the origin as issue #42 (verified live). One further
caveat: two of the fifteen "translated" files received their modules in **English, verbatim**.

## 3. Rehearsal file consumed — REFUTED (claim false; behaviour self-reported by the agent)

```
$ ls -la .kaif/update-rehearsal.json
-rw-r--r-- 1 krinik 197121 2328 Sep  4 17:13 .kaif/update-rehearsal.json
```

**The file exists.** Its mtime (17:13) predates the live update (`kaif.json` history: `17:14:59`),
so it was never deleted and never re-created — the "one-shot" contract did not run.

Root cause, read from the deployed machinery:

```
$ grep -n "consumeRehearsal\|loadRehearsal" .kaif/kaif-core.mjs
1605:  const rehearsal = loadRehearsal(cur.version, man.version);   ← cmdUpdate
1690:  consumeRehearsal(rehearsal);                                 ← cmdUpdate, the ONLY call
1724:function loadRehearsal(from, to) {
1737:function consumeRehearsal(r) { if (r && !r.explicit) { try { unlinkSync(r.path); } catch { } } }
2314:      cls = classifyAndApply(deploy, baseline, values, unresolved, legacyOld, null, loadRehearsal(legacyOld.version, meta.version));
```

`consumeRehearsal` is reachable only from `cmdUpdate`. This update took the **bootstrap** route
(`"route": "bootstrap"` in both marker and receipt; the live log ends `✅ KAIF 2.5 deployed
mechanically`, the install tail, not `✅ KAIF updated mechanically to 2.5`). Line 2314 loads the
rehearsal on that route and never consumes it. The comment at line 1735 — *"The auto record is
one-shot: consumed by the update it rehearsed"* — is false on the route the canon recommends for
`i18n: translated` deployments.

**This is not a cover-up.** `bugs/KAIF/05_update_rehearsal_flag_unreachable_on_bootstrap_route.md`
carries the identical finding, in the agent's own words, with the same `ls` evidence:

> **The same non-composition, second face: on the bootstrap route the auto record is never
> CONSUMED.** `consumeRehearsal()` is called once, at `cmdUpdate` (kaif-core.mjs:1690); the
> bootstrap classify calls `loadRehearsal(...)` (kaif-core.mjs:2314) and nothing else.

Delivered upstream, verified live and read-only:

```
$ gh issue view 42 --repo MikalaiKryvusha/KAIF --json number,title,state,author,createdAt
{"author":{"login":"MikalaiKryvusha"},"createdAt":"2026-09-04T14:36:35Z","number":42,"state":"OPEN",
 "title":"KAIF improvement request: the update canon hands a sandbox receipt to `update --rehearsal`,
  but the bootstrap route it recommends for translated deployments cannot take the flag"}
```

**Blast radius: negligible.** The path is git-ignored (`.gitignore:94`), so it cannot enter a
commit, and `loadRehearsal` refuses a record whose `from`/`to` do not match the next interval — the
2.4→2.5 record will be named and ignored by the 2.5→2.6 run.

**The claim, not the work, is what fails here.** Whoever relayed "it was consumed" asserted
something the agent's own ticket contradicts.

Second-order finding, also already self-reported in the same ticket (§ "Side observation"): the
rehearsal recorded **16** verdicts, the receipt carries **15** — `diff --source` counts
`MASTER_PLAN.md` as a candidate and `classifyAndApply` does not. Nothing fired because the extra
file is never compared, but the canon promises the two lists "compare line by line". I reached this
independently before reading the ticket; the ticket had it first.
